title: 第11章 障眼法
content_zh:
“我若顾惜自己的性命，杜相公走后，我就不会再回到这庐州城。”
陆凤台断喝了一声，看着聂仲由好一会，终于叹道：“淮右的形势不比当年了，别的不说，连我都知道，军饷都已经拖了一年，城头的防事都三年没修了。这些年淮右军民协力抗蒙，真的快熬到头了。你问我要准备什么？我不知道，但至少……等转运司的拨银下来？”
聂仲由摇了摇头，拿起刀，在地上画起来。
他画的是一个简单的地图，一边画，一边嘴里说着话。
“知道为什么吗？蒙军灭了大理之后，两广、湖南就成为了前线，朝廷必须分兵南下，建一个新的防线，这让财政有了很大的亏空……”
聂仲由可能只是听某位重臣说过一些这方面的事，在财赋之事上他显然没有太深的理解，只能用‘很大的亏空’这样的词。
此时他已画完了地图。
李瑕原本有些疑惑……蒙古在北边，大理在南边，蒙军怎么会不先灭了宋而去先灭了大理国？
但现在一看，他就明白了。
如今蒙古汗国已经征服了大半个亚洲，其疆域已把这个宋朝整个包围起来。
换言之，它的疆域，在宋朝西边都连成一片了。
反正按聂仲由画的，大理国被灭之后，这宋朝但凡不是临海的地方，就是与蒙古汗国接壤。
当然，这只是聂仲由画的。东南亚与南亚应该还存留着一些小国，只是他懒得画上去。
聂仲由画完地图，在图上的西南方位敲了敲。
“你说淮右军饷不济，但若不解决大理的问题。朝廷的亏空只会一年大过一年。而我奉命前来，正是因为朝中相公们在设法解决此事。”
“借口。”陆凤台摇了摇头，讥笑道：“拿千里之外的番邦之事来当亏空的借口，蒙我们这些大头兵，不可笑吗？”
他摆了摆手，又道：“聂兄你不要被人骗了。亏空到底怎么来的？与大理国被灭有没有关系？这些事，朝中重臣怎么说我不管，我只知道，眼下这个时候淮右打不起这一仗。”
“无论如此，我们该尽力助大理国遗民抗蒙。”聂仲由又道：“你可知‘斡腹’？蒙人通过四面合围来狩捕猎物、攻击其柔软的腹部。他们灭大理，为的是能攻我大宋腹地。而我所为，并非在管别国的命运，为的是保护我们自己的腹地。”
“大理国已经被灭了，这是不可挽回之事。当务之急是什么？是布置好两淮防御，延缓蒙军南下，而不像你们这样胡作非为，给蒙人以借口。”
“别自欺欺人了，难道夹着尾巴做人就能指望蒙人不打我们吗？自杜相公走后，那些淮右将士，如今已成了这般贪生怕死之徒不成？！”

“你提相杜公是吗？当年金国新灭，朝廷非要收复三京，杜相极力反对，但就是拦不住当时那些像你们这种‘满腔热忱’之士，于是信誓旦旦出师河洛，收复三京，满朝沸腾。可结果呢？轻启边衅，引得蒙军来攻，六万大军半数丧命于淮河以北，寸土未得，官家罪己，兵民丧胆！”
陆凤台话到这里，收了收怒气，苦口婆心道：“我不知你背后是什么人，但能参与此事，又与吕太尉有联络，必是朝中重臣，为何就不能吃一堑长一智？莫再用那份鲁莽的热忱妨害家国大业了，行不行？！”
“到底是谁在妨害家国大业？！”
“聂仲由，你能不能听我一句劝？！”
“陆凤台，你如今成了求和派脚下的一条狗不成？！”
李瑕以为这两人要打起来，但见他们瞪着对方看了一会，胸膛起伏，最后又各自冷静下来。
陆凤台道：“我劝你一句，要是见到那些逃犯，交给我。”
聂仲由道：“都这般说了，你还不肯放过他们？他们也在抗蒙，你要把与我们并肩作战的同袍交给敌人？”
“大理人是外族人，不是我并肩作战的同袍。”
陆凤台说着，转身往外走去，又叹息了一句：“聂兄，我是奉命行事，你别怪我。”
聂仲由淡淡道：“我也是奉命行事。”
等陆凤如离开客房，聂仲由转向李瑕，问道：“你都听明白了？”
“大概吧。”李瑕道：“真正有意义的细节我都还不知道。”
聂仲由问道：“你觉得陆凤台有没有捉到我们要找的人？”
李瑕反问道：“这些高氏余部有几个人？”
“五个。”
“陆凤台肯定是没捉到全部人，否则就不会留下那个老人在长丰街守株待兔了，也不会来试探你了。”
“你觉得他来找我，还有没有别的目的？”
李瑕道：“他派人监视我们，被你发现了，否则他可能会一直监视我们。他来找你，是想打草惊蛇，让你尽快就去找到高氏余部，他好捉人交差。这说明他的差事是有时限的，他比我们急。”
“我也没太多时间在这里耗着。”

“哦。”
“此事我打算交给你办。”
“你相信我吗？”
“至少，你肯定不会是求和派安插进队伍中的。”
这么说，李瑕忽然觉得聂仲由也不容易，沉吟道：“但刚才陆凤台已经见过我了。”
聂仲由道：“我故意的，我会把信物交给你，由你出面去找人。同时再派一个兵士暗中去探访。如此一来，你在明，他在暗。”
“哦。”
“但事实上，在明面上的你才是真正要与高氏接触的人。”
李瑕道：“你这个障眼法并不高明，陆凤台肯定还是会派人监视我。”
聂仲由：“但你很聪明，我相信你能避开他的眼线找到高氏。”
“那你做什么？”
“我会牵制着陆凤台，等你把高氏平安带出庐州，我再去与你汇合。”
“好吧。”李瑕伸手接过那枚铜制令牌，道：“告诉我那些人的特点。”
聂仲由道：“我也不知道……”
陆凤台离开客栈之后，在长街上绕了一圈，确定聂仲由没有派人跟着自己之后，走进了一间茶楼。
这间茶楼与承平客栈的后门只隔了一条小巷，从茶楼上看去，正好能看到聂仲由所住的那个客院。
他饮了一杯茶，看到远处的客院里，有个商队护卫打扮的人走进了聂仲由的屋子。
又过了一会，只见一身白衣的李瑕从屋子里走了出来，在客院中站立了一会，四下望了望，又离开了客栈。
“樊三，你去盯着他。”陆凤台吩咐道。
“是。”

樊三拱手应喏，脚步匆匆离开茶楼。
陆凤台依旧端坐着，一边饮茶，一边盯着远处聂仲由的屋子。
然而，一整壶茶水下肚，始终不见那个护卫出来。
陆凤台微微笑了笑，转过头向楼梯口看去。
不一会儿，一个手下快步上来，低声禀报道：“都头，果然有人偷偷从承天客栈的院墙翻出去了，身手不错，已有两个弟兄跟了上去……”
content_en:
"If I care about my life, I will never return to Luzhou City after Mr. Du leaves."
Lu Fengtai gave a loud shout, looked at Nie Zhongyou for a long time, and finally sighed: "The situation in Huaiyou is no longer what it was back then. Not to mention anything else, even I know that military pay has been delayed for a year, and the defenses on the city haven't been repaired for three years. The military and civilian efforts of Huaiyou in these years are really coming to an end. What should I prepare? I don't know, but at least... wait for the money from the Transportation Department to come down?"
Nie Zhongyou shook his head, picked up the knife, and started drawing on the ground.
He drew a simple map and spoke while drawing.
"Do you know why? After the Mongolian army destroyed Dali, Guangdong, Guangxi, and Hunan became the front lines. The imperial court had to divide its troops and go south to build a new line of defense. This caused a huge financial deficit..."
Nie Zhongyou may have just heard something about this from a certain important minister. He obviously didn't have a deep understanding of the matter of wealth and could only use words like 'big deficit'.
By this time he had finished drawing the map.
Li Xia was originally a little confused... Mongolia was in the north and Dali was in the south. How could the Mongolian army destroy Dali first instead of destroying Song Dynasty first?
But now that he saw it, he understood.
Now the Mongol Khanate has conquered most of Asia, and its territory has surrounded the entire Song Dynasty.
In other words, its territory was connected to the west of the Song Dynasty.
Anyway, according to Nie Zhongyou's painting, after the destruction of Dali, the Song Dynasty was either near the sea or bordering the Mongol Khanate.
Of course, this is just a painting by Nie Zhongyou. There should still be some small countries in Southeast Asia and South Asia, but he was too lazy to draw them.
After Nie Zhongyou finished drawing the map, he tapped the southwest direction on the map.
"You said that the Huaiyou army is poorly paid, but if the problem in Dali is not solved, the court's deficit will only get bigger year by year. And I was ordered to come here precisely because the ministers in the court are trying to solve this matter."
"Excuse." Lu Fengtai shook his head and sneered, "Isn't it ridiculous to use the affairs of a foreign country thousands of miles away as an excuse to suffer losses, and to deceive us big-headed soldiers?"
He waved his hand and said: "Brother Nie, don't be deceived. How did the deficit come about? Is it related to the destruction of Dali? I don't care about these things, no matter what the important ministers say, I only know that Huaiyou cannot fight this battle at this time."
"In any case, we should try our best to help the remnants of Dali to fight against the Mongols." Nie Zhongyou said again: "Do you know about the 'good service'? The Mongols hunted prey and attacked their soft belly by encircling them on all sides. They destroyed Dali in order to attack the hinterland of the Song Dynasty. What I did was not to care about the fate of other countries, but to protect our own hinterland."
"The Dali Kingdom has been destroyed. This is irreversible. What is the top priority? It is to arrange the defenses of the Huaihe River and delay the Mongolian army from going south, instead of acting recklessly like you and giving the Mongolian people an excuse."
"Don't deceive yourself. How can we expect others not to hit us if we keep our tail between our legs? Since Du Xianggong left, those Huaiyou soldiers have now become such greedy and fearful people?!"
"Are you proposing Prime Minister Du Gong? When the Jin Kingdom was newly destroyed, the imperial court insisted on regaining the three capitals. Prime Minister Du strongly opposed it, but he couldn't stop those 'enthusiastic' people like you at that time, so he vowed to go to Heluo and recapture the three capitals, and the whole court was excited. But what was the result? A slight provocation attracted the Mongolian army to attack, and half of the 60,000 troops were killed north of the Huaihe River. Without an inch of land, the officials were guilty, and the soldiers and the people were frightened!"
At this point, Lu Fengtai calmed down his anger and said earnestly: "I don't know who is behind you, but to be involved in this matter and to be in contact with Lieutenant Lu, he must be an important official in the court. Why can't you learn from the mistakes and gain wisdom? Don't use that reckless enthusiasm to hinder the great cause of the family and the country, okay?!"
"Who is hindering the great cause of our country?!"
"Nie Zhongyou, can you listen to me?A word of advice? ! "
"Lu Fengtai, have you become a dog at the feet of the peace-seeking faction? ! "
Li Xia thought the two were about to fight, but saw them staring at each other for a while, their chests rising and falling, and finally they calmed down.
Lu Fengtai said: "I advise you, if you see those fugitives, leave them to me. "
Nie Zhongyou said: "You have said so, but you still refuse to let them go? They are also fighting against Mongolia. Do you want to hand over our comrades who are fighting alongside us to the enemy? "
"The Dali people are foreigners, not my comrades fighting alongside me. "
Lu Fengtai said, turned around and walked out, sighing again: "Brother Nie, I am following orders, don't blame me. "
Nie Zhongyou said calmly: "I am also following orders. "
After Lu Fengru left the guest room, Nie Zhongyou turned to Li Xia and asked, "Do you understand? "
"I guess so. Li Xia said, "I don't even know the really meaningful details yet." "
Nie Zhongyou asked: "Do you think Lu Fengtai has caught the person we are looking for? "
Li Xia asked: "How many of these remaining members of the Gao family are there? "
"Five. "
"Lu Fengtai must have not caught everyone, otherwise he wouldn't have left the old man waiting in Changfeng Street, and he wouldn't have come to test you. "
"Do you think he has any other purpose for coming to me? "
Li Xia said: "He sent someone to monitor us, and you discovered it, otherwise he might have been monitoring us. He comes to you because he wants to alert you and ask you to find the rest of the Gao family as soon as possible so that he can catch people and make trouble. This shows that his errand is time-limited and he is in a hurry than we are. "
“I don’t have much time to spend here. "
"oh. "
“I plan to leave this matter to you. "
"Do you believe me? "
"At least, you will definitely not be inserted into the team by the peace-seeking faction. "
Saying this, Li Xia suddenly felt that Nie Zhongyou was not easy either, and said thoughtfully: "But Lu Fengtai has already seen me just now. "
Nie Zhongyou said: "I did it on purpose, I will give you the token and you will go out and find the person. At the same time, another soldier was sent to visit secretly. In this way, you are in the light and he is in the dark. "
"oh. "
"But in fact, you are the one who really wants to have contact with Mr. Gao on the surface. "
Li Xia said: "Your deception is not very clever, Lu Fengtai will definitely send someone to monitor me. "
Nie Zhongyou: "But you are very smart, I believe you can avoid his eyes and find Gao. "
"Then what do you do? "
"I will contain Lu Fengtai and wait until you bring the Gao family out of Luzhou safely, then I will join you. "
"All right. Li Xia reached out to take the copper token and said, "Tell me the characteristics of those people." "
Nie Zhongyou said: "I don't know either..."
After Lu Fengtai left the inn, he walked around the long street to make sure that Nie Zhongyou had not sent anyone to follow him, and then walked into a teahouse.
This teahouse is only separated from the back door of Taiping Inn by an alley. From the teahouse, you can just see the guest house where Nie Zhongyou lives.
He drank a cup of tea and saw a man dressed as a caravan guard walking into Nie Zhongyou's house in the distant guest courtyard.
After a while, Li Xia, dressed in white, walked out of the house, stood in the guest courtyard for a while, looked around, and then left the inn.
"Fan San, go and keep an eye on him. Lu Fengtai ordered.
"Yes. "
Fan San cupped his hands in response and hurriedly left the teahouse.
Lu Fengtai was still sitting upright, drinking tea and staring at Nie Zhongyou's house in the distance.
However, after drinking a whole pot of tea, the guard never came out.
Lu Fengtai smiled slightly and turned his head to look at the stairs.
After a while, a subordinate came up quickly and reported in a low voice: "Du Tou, as expected, someone secretly climbed out of the courtyard wall of Chengtian Inn. He is very skilled. Two brothers have followed him..."
